name: infra-pane
description: Live view of the local infra testbed (~/infra): which compose services are up, the OrbStack k8s cluster and its namespaces' pods, Tailscale state, wiki-serve and its mode (public only / full), with stop buttons, wiki-serve on/off and mode switch, and the k8s toggle; a status line while anything runs; /infra opens it.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Poll ~/infra every 20 s, show the pane and the status line. Off: no polling, pane closed, /infra answers that it is off.
